preview.body: You’re not a member of {name} yet. Join it, or create a platform of your own.

onboarding.meetBody: Your platform’s agent is ready whenever you are.
onboarding.allSetMember: Thanks — your platform has what it needs. Head in.

sample.body: You’re looking at sample data: fictional prospects, schools and applications. Your own platform starts empty and is yours to run.

chat.title: Chat with admissions
chat.notice: You’re chatting with an AI agent, not a person. It answers from {institution}’s published information and can bring in a counselor.
chat.unavailableBody: The link may be out of date. Please contact the admissions office directly.
chat.busy: The agent can’t answer right now. Please contact the admissions office.
chat.noticeAnswers: You’re chatting with an AI agent, not a person. It answers from {institution}’s published information.

page.askBody: Our AI agent answers in seconds, at any hour.
page.closed: Sign-ups for this event have closed.
page.tagsGoogle: This page uses a Google tag to measure sign-ups.
page.tagsMeta: This page uses a Meta Pixel to measure sign-ups.
page.tagsBoth: This page uses Google and Meta tags to measure sign-ups.

pages.eventHint: An open house or a visit day: the page shows the date, and sign-ups close on time.
pages.briefHint: Say what the page is for in a sentence or two. Recruit drafts it from your sources, and you review it before anything is published.
pages.briefPlaceholder: Open house for admitted nursing students, Saturday March 13. Tour the simulation lab, meet faculty, sign up by March 9.
pages.draftFailed: Recruit could not draft this page. {reason}
pages.courseBriefPlaceholder: Optional: anything to emphasize, such as the simulation lab or clinical placements.
pages.courseHint: Recruit writes a few short lessons about this program from your sources. You review them before anything is published.
pages.lessonsHint: A short taster course: 2 to 6 lessons, read without an account, above the chat.
pages.courseNeedsProgram: Enter the program below, then draft the course. Recruit writes a few short lessons about it from your sources.

needsYou.title: Needs you
needsYou.emptyBody: Handoffs from Recruit, messages waiting to be sent and pages waiting for approval show here.
needsYou.subject: Subject
needsYou.notSending: Recruit sends nothing itself. Send it from your own mail or phone, then mark it sent.
needsYou.sendsVia: Approve and send goes out through {connector}. Nothing leaves until you press it.
needsYou.sendUnknown: It is not known whether this message went out. Check the mailbox, then mark it sent or send it from your own mail.
needsYou.shortlistHint: Tick who to keep. Nothing is kept about anyone else.
needsYou.addStopped: Added {added} before {name} could not be added: {detail}
needsYou.shortlistNotCleared: The shortlist could not be cleared, so it stays open: {detail}
needsYou.shortlistAdded: {added, plural, one {# prospect added} other {# prospects added}}{onFile, plural, =0 {} other {, # already on file}}
needsYou.dmByHand: A staff member sends this from the university’s own account.
needsYou.leftApproved: Already approved; it may have gone out
needsYou.copyStopped: Added {added} before {name} could not be copied to the CRM app: {detail}. Press Add selected again to finish.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.notFound: This conversation could not be loaded
conversations.notFoundBody: It may be older than the platform keeps, or your role may not read conversations.
conversations.noAgent: Recruit is not set up yet
conversations.noAgentBody: An admin sets it up under Recruit.

agent.title: Recruit
agent.setupBody: Recruit is the AI agent prospective students talk to on your landing pages and your website. Setup creates it on your platform; signing visitors up and handing over from chat are connected once this app has a public https address.
agent.voiceHint: A few plain sentences: the tone, what to call the university, what to avoid. Recruit’s rules stay as they are.
agent.sites: Sites that may show the chat
agent.sitesHint: One address per line, like https://www.example.edu. Until a site is listed here, the chat will not load inside it.
agent.sitesInvalid: Use full addresses that start with https://, with nothing after the site’s name.
agent.snippet: Paste this before </body> on your site
agent.toolsOn: Answers questions, signs visitors up and hands over to a counselor.
agent.toolsOff: Answers questions only. Signing up and handing over from chat need this app at a public https address.
agent.emailOn: Through {connector}, one approved message at a time.
agent.emailOff: Choose a mail connector under Settings, Connectors. Until then a person sends each message from their own mail.

scoreboard.title: Scoreboard
scoreboard.afterHoursNote: Weekdays 9 to 5, in this browser’s time zone.
scoreboard.movesNote: From the stage changes the platform recorded.
scoreboard.replyNote: Per call to the model; one answer takes several.
scoreboard.whereNote: Last 90 days: students the agents proposed on each channel and in each place they looked, and how many a person kept.
scoreboard.whereNone: No students found in the last 90 days.

ads.title: Ad measurement
ads.body: Landing pages load these tags for every visitor and report each sign-up as a conversion. Leave a field empty to load nothing.
ads.adsLabelHint: From the conversion action in Google Ads. Needs an AW- tag ID.
ads.invalid: That does not look like a valid ID.

settings.needsAgent: Set up the Chief of Staff first.
settings.outreachBody: Every morning the Chief of Staff works out who is due a message, writes each one and leaves it under Needs you. Nothing is sent until a person approves it.
settings.outreachOn: Scheduled: every day at {time}, by this browser’s clock. The list below shows the platform’s clock, which is UTC.
settings.connectorsBody: Connectors give the Chief of Staff tools from other systems. Anything added here is attached to it, so add only what it should be able to use on its own.
settings.mailBody: Choose the connector to the university’s mailbox. It is given to a separate sending agent that acts only when someone presses Approve and send. The Chief of Staff never has it, and only an admin can send through it.
settings.mailNone: None: messages are sent by hand
settings.addressHint: Added to the foot of an email to someone the university found and has not heard from.
settings.mailHint: The list holds the connectors your platform added itself. Add the mailbox with Add Connector below, then choose it here.
settings.findingBody: Asked to find students, or on a saved search’s schedule, the Chief of Staff reads public posts on Instagram, Reddit, X and YouTube through Apify’s scrapers and proposes a shortlist under Needs you. A person picks who is kept: each gets their channel as a tag and a copy in the CRM app, and their public profile on that channel can be read into their record. Of the rest only their handle is kept, for 90 days, so they aren’t proposed again; the platform’s audit log and the agent’s chat history still hold what a search found, which platform admins can read. The first message to someone found is one a staff member sends by hand; someone found on YouTube, which has no direct messages, is not written to.
settings.findingBasis: Why the university may contact people it finds
settings.findingBasisHint: Kept with every shortlist and every person added. Whether public posts may be collected, and their authors written to, depends on each channel’s terms and on the law where the university works: that is its counsel’s decision, not this app’s.
settings.findingOff: Finding is off until this is written. Whether public posts may be collected, and their authors written to, depends on each channel’s terms and on the law where the university works: that is its counsel’s decision, not this app’s.
settings.findingAddressHint: Add this address as a connector below, in place of Apify’s standard one. It gives the agent these scrapers and Apify’s tools for reading their results, and no way to run any other Actor in the account. The X scrapers need a paid Apify plan.
settings.findingOpen: The Apify connector “{name}” is not limited to these scrapers: the agent can run other Actors in that Apify account, including ones that log in and send messages. Replace it with the address above.
settings.dailyDraftsHint: The most messages the agents may write in 24 hours on this platform, from 1 to 500. Each one still waits for a person.
settings.findingKeyIgnored: The key on “{name}” is stored but never used: the platform sends a connector’s own key only when it is shared by everyone who uses the agent. Share it so the Chief of Staff can run these scrapers.
settings.findingKeyShared: The Chief of Staff can use the key now.
settings.searchesBody: The Chief of Staff runs each search on its own clock through the Apify connector and leaves who it finds as a shortlist under Needs you. A person still picks who is kept.
settings.searchesNeedBasis: No search runs until an admin writes, under Connectors, why the university may contact people it finds.
settings.searchWhereHint: Hashtags, subreddits or search terms. Left empty, the Chief of Staff chooses.
settings.searchStarted: It starts within a minute; who it finds waits under Needs you.

found.doNotContactHint: Set by a person only. Agents cannot change it.
found.title: Found
found.enrichOptedOut: They asked not to be contacted, so nothing more is gathered about them.
found.copyNotUpdated: Saved here, but the CRM app’s copy wasn’t updated: {detail}
